fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Mark each detached structure with a visible identifier so responders can distinguish and communicate structure locations quickly.
• Clear a defined path between the main residence and each detached structure so responders can move between buildings without pushing through vegetation.
• Trim dense vegetation along any side or rear walls of all structures so responders can walk the perimeter of each building.
• Keep the storage area organized so access around and behind it remains clear for responders on foot.
• Remove or relocate any vehicles or equipment parked in areas that block movement between structures.
• Identify the farthest accessible point on the driveway and mark it clearly so responders know where to stage without blocking their own exit.
• If the driveway does not allow a vehicle to turn around, post a sign at the entrance indicating it is a dead end so responding drivers can plan accordingly.
• Keep a gap in dense vegetation near each structure so a hose line can be advanced to the building without obstruction.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster closest to the structure to create open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure's exterior walls.
• Trim lower branches on large trees near the structure to reduce the path flames can take from ground vegetation up into the tree canopy.
• Clear dead or dry plant material from beneath scattered shrubs near the structure.
• Separate individual vegetation groups so gaps exist between them and the structure.
• Keep the area under large trees near the structure clear of shrubs and loose plant debris.
• Maintain existing open terrain areas by preventing shrub or tree encroachment into those spaces.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs to allow vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Trim scattered trees near the structure so their branches do not touch or overhang the roofline.
